steps.title: Open the Data Manager to see factor lab refresh status
steps.narration: The Data Manager shows what aggregates were refreshed during each data-loading job. Let's check the most recent run to confirm the new factor lab warm completed successfully.
steps.point_out: Look for the 'Refreshed:' line in the Job progress card — it now includes 'factor lab all'.

steps.title: Verify factor lab all appears in the completed job's refresh list
steps.narration: This tells us the ingest-time factor lab warm ran during the job's finalize step. The page already shows this status for completed runs.
steps.point_out: The gray text under the job card reads 'Refreshed: … factor lab all, coverage, research hot keys, …' — a new entry this iteration.

steps.title: Navigate to the Factor Lab research page
steps.narration: Opening Factor Lab used to sometimes trigger a live, multi-minute computation on first visit after new data loaded. That computation now runs during ingest instead, so the page responds immediately.
steps.point_out: Notice the page loads with data in just a few seconds — no multi-minute 'Still computing' amber card.

steps.title: Confirm the factor table loads with real data
steps.narration: The all-factors comparison is now served from the cache warmed at ingest time, delivering real numbers immediately instead of waiting for a live compute.
steps.point_out: The table shows 11 real factor rows (e.g., 'Leadership score') with numeric columns like 'N', 'Mean', 'Rank IC'. No placeholder data, no 'Still computing' notice.

steps.title: Return to Factor Lab and test sort interaction
steps.narration: The sort controls work client-side on the cached data. Click a column header to verify rows re-order without a page reload.
steps.point_out: Clicking the 'N' header flips the sort direction, rows re-order immediately, and the sort indicator shows the new direction.

steps.title: Click the N column header to trigger a client-side sort
steps.narration: Sorting should be instant on cache-warmed data.
steps.point_out: Rows re-order without any spinner or network request.

steps.title: Expand a factor row to view its decile distribution
steps.narration: Clicking a row reveals its D1–D10 decile breakdown. This detail view also works instantly on the cached data.
steps.point_out: The first row expands to show a decile grid below it — no error, no loading delay.

steps.title: Open the Research hub to confirm Factor Lab is discoverable
steps.narration: Factor Lab remains accessible from the main Research page, unchanged in wording and position.
steps.point_out: The 'Factor Lab' tile is present in the lab grid. Clicking it navigates back to the Factor Lab page.
